slides.headline: The US just grounded every single flight
slides.subline: **More than 9,100 flights were canceled** on Nov. 13, according to FlightAware.

slides.body: On **Friday, Nov. 13**, the FAA ordered a [[nationwide ground stop]]. No plane could take off anywhere in the US. It lasted **more than four hours**, the longest of its kind since 9/11.
FlightAware counted **9,100+ canceled flights** and **24,500+ delayed** flights that day. Air travel was still [[slowly recovering]] days later.

The FAA blamed [[intermittent telecom outages]]. Reports point to a router at a communications site that was being upgraded. The probe is still open. Homeland Security saw **no sign of an attack** but ruled nothing out.
Hours earlier, a separate **Microsoft 365 outage** hit users worldwide. Officials said the two were [[not connected]]. Should systems this critical be this fragile? Tell us below.
